$comment: Named run matrices. A group crosses its models, its arms, the first `tasksPerRepo` tasks of every repository and `repeats` repeats. `plan --matrix <name>` prints the runs and their estimated cost. See bench/v2/README.md for what each size can and cannot conclude.

mock.description: Offline end-to-end check with the scripted mock model: every repository, every arm, no network, no key.

canary.description: One task, the two extreme arms, the small and mid models: checks each API adapter against the live API and measures real cost per run before a larger matrix.

small.description: Small models only, every arm, every task, 3 repeats.

standard.description: The proposal: small models with 3 repeats plus mid models with 1, every arm, every task.

large.description: Small and mid models with 3 repeats, plus one run of each frontier model, every arm, every task.
